S27.01.needs: a signed-in account and a document made in chat
S27.01.note: The fallback text is Untitled in the card and viewer; the card uses artifactTitle() and the viewer uses artifact.title || 'Untitled'.
steps: Sign in and open a chat that has a document made by Claude.
Look at the document card in the reply: it shows the document title.
Click the card to open the document in the side panel.
Look at the viewer title. Compare with Expected: a title shows, and a document with no title shows Untitled.
S27.01.where: Chat > open a conversation that has a document > the document card in the reply shows its title. Open it: the viewer header shows the same title.

S27.03.needs: a signed-in account and a document made in chat (not a code artifact)
S27.03.note: Edit opens the rich editor, which falls back to a plain Markdown text view for content it cannot keep (math, footnotes, raw HTML); there is no separate raw-source toggle found for normal Markdown documents.
steps: Open a document made in chat in the side panel. Stay on the Preview tab.
Click Edit in the header (or open the More menu and choose Edit source).
Change the text in the editor.
Click Save. Compare with Expected: the text is saved as a new version and the viewer shows it.
S27.03.where: Chat > open a document > Preview tab > Edit (Edit document). Or More menu > Edit source. Then Save or Cancel.

S27.06.needs: a signed-in account and a document made in chat
S27.06.note: Underline has no control in DocumentFormattingToolbar.tsx, and the editor extensions list did not show it, so the Expected underline part is not met by the code.
steps: Open a document in the side panel and click Edit.
Select some words.
Click Bold, then Italic, then Link (Link asks for a web address and adds it to the selection).
Look at the text. Compare with Expected: bold and italic show, and the link is set. Underline was not found in the toolbar.
S27.06.where: Chat > open a document > Preview tab > Edit > select text > formatting toolbar: Bold, Italic, Link.

S27.07.needs: a signed-in account and a document made in chat
S27.07.note: Checklist ticks in the Preview tab save as a new version after a short pause, according to CHECKLIST_COMMIT_IDLE_MS.
steps: Open a document in the side panel and click Edit.
Click Bulleted list, then Numbered list, and type items.
Click Checklist and type a few items.
Tick a checklist box in the Preview tab. Compare with Expected: all three list types appear and checkboxes toggle.
S27.07.where: Chat > open a document > Preview tab > Edit > formatting toolbar: Bulleted list, Numbered list, Checklist.

S27.08.needs: a signed-in account and a document made in chat
S27.08.note: Table rendering is in packages/ui/unified-chat/src/components/markdown/remarkPlugins.ts; the tester should check that cell editing and row/column controls exist, since the code only shows the insert control.
steps: Open a document in the side panel and click Edit.
Click Insert table in the formatting toolbar.
Type text into the table cells.
Look at the table. Compare with Expected: a table is inserted and it can be edited.
S27.08.where: Chat > open a document > Preview tab > Edit > formatting toolbar: Insert table.

S27.09.needs: a document that has an image link
S27.09.note: Images render in the Markdown preview (MarkdownContent.tsx renders img and asks approval for external hosts), but no insert-image control was found in DocumentFormattingToolbar.tsx or ArtifactPreview.tsx; searched for Insert image and label="Image" under apps/web/features/chat/components/artifacts and packages/ui/unified-chat.

S27.11.needs: a signed-in account and a document made in chat
S27.11.note: Math equations have no insert control; remarkMath is enabled for rendering only, and the editor says math documents open as Markdown.
steps: Open a document in the side panel and click Edit.
Click Code block in the toolbar and type a few lines of code.
Click Save and go to the Preview tab.
Look at the code block. Compare with Expected: it shows as a code block. Math has no toolbar control.
S27.11.where: Chat > open a document > Preview tab > Edit > formatting toolbar: Code block (also under the Text style menu).

S27.12.needs: a document with 3 or more headings
S27.12.note: The Outline control appears only when the document has at least 3 headings (OUTLINE_MIN_HEADINGS = 3).
steps: Open a document that has at least 3 headings in the side panel.
Stay on the Preview tab and click Outline.
Click one heading in the list.
Look at the page. Compare with Expected: the view jumps to that section.
S27.12.where: Chat > open a document with 3 or more headings > Preview tab > Outline.

S27.27.needs: a signed-in account and a document made in chat
S27.27.note: The code keeps a local draft on the device and shows Draft kept on this device or Draft not kept; there is no Saving or Saved state, and a version is created only on Save (or a checklist pause).
steps: Open a document in the side panel and click Edit.
Type a sentence.
Look at the header next to Save: it shows Draft kept on this device, or Draft not kept.
Click Save and check that a new version is listed in Version history. Compare with Expected: the document saves on its own and shows saving and saved states.
S27.27.where: Chat > open a document > Preview tab > Edit > type text > look at the header next to Save.

S27.28.needs: a signed-in account and a document with more than one saved version
S27.28.note: Undo and Redo step through saved versions, not each keystroke, and show only in the side panel for saved documents; keyboard undo inside the editor was not verified.
steps: Open a saved document that has been edited at least once, in the side panel.
Click Edit, change text, and click Save so a new version exists.
Click the Undo last change button in the header.
Click Redo change, and compare with Expected: the previous text returns and then the newer text returns.
S27.28.where: Chat > open a document with more than one version > side panel header: Undo last change and Redo change buttons (also in the More menu as Undo and Redo).

S27.29.needs: a signed-in account and a document with several versions
S27.29.note: The date and time use the browser locale (toLocaleString, medium date and short time).
steps: Open a document that has several versions in the side panel.
Click the Version history button in the header.
Read the list: each version shows its number, Latest on the newest, and its date and time.
Click a version to open it, click Restore, confirm Restore in the dialog, and compare with Expected: the restored text shows and a new version is added.
S27.29.where: Chat > open a document with more than one version > Version history button in the header > click Version 1 (or any version) > Restore.

S27.35.needs: a signed-in account and a document made in chat
S27.35.note: The item appears only for text documents (isTextDocument).
steps: Open a document in the side panel.
Click the Download button in the header (aria label Download artifact).
Click Download as Word (.docx).
Open the saved file in Word or Pages. Compare with Expected: a .docx file with the document text opens.
S27.35.where: Chat > open a document > Download (the Download artifact button) > Download as Word (.docx).

S27.36.needs: a signed-in account and a document made in chat
S27.36.note: The same label also appears for deck export; for a text document it is the document PDF export.
steps: Open a document in the side panel.
Click the Download button in the header.
Click Download as PDF.
Open the saved PDF. Compare with Expected: a PDF file with the document text opens.
S27.36.where: Chat > open a document > Download (the Download artifact button) > Download as PDF.

S27.37.needs: a signed-in account and a document made in chat
S27.37.note: For a Markdown document the file contains the document text as is; for other artifacts it wraps the code in a fenced block.
steps: Open a document in the side panel.
Click the Download button in the header.
Click Download as Markdown.
Open the saved .md file in a text editor. Compare with Expected: the file is Markdown text with the document content.
S27.37.where: Chat > open a document > Download (the Download artifact button) > Download as Markdown.
